$comment: Controls that are deliberately inert, whose effect is proven by another spec, or that this gate found broken and that a tracked issue now covers. Every entry needs a route, a control key, a one line justification of at least 25 characters, and an owner. covered_elsewhere entries additionally need a spec file that exists and a marker string that file actually contains. known_broken entries need an issue number, so the entry expires when the defect is fixed. Stale entries fail the gate. See README.md in this directory.

entries.reason: Recharts renders its chart surface focusable with role application, but the chart itself has no activation behaviour: every control that changes it is a sibling that this gate proves separately
submitting without a valid recovery session answers a generic server error with a support reference instead of saying the reset link is missing or expired
